Win the game. Survive early. Expand early into neutral centres.
Ally with a neighbour who keeps promises. Ally with a neighbour when the leader is strong.
Do not ally with a distant power early.
Support an ally when they are attacked. Support an ally when a support wins a centre.
Do not attack an ally early. Attack an enemy when the enemy is weak. Attack the leader when the leader is strong. Balance the leader late.
Stab an ally only when the gain wins the game. Before a stab, remember what you told that power.
Promise only when you mean it. Keep a promise. Do not promise a hold in a province you plan to attack. Do not promise a move you will not make.
Trust only orders. When a power breaks a promise, distrust that power. When a power keeps a promise, trust that power. When you cannot tell, ask. Do not plan on a promise that is disputed.
Expect others to lie.
Talk briefly. Be cold. Do not flatter. Do not plead. Send few messages.
Hold when outnumbered. Defend a home centre. Retreat when attacked without support.
Convoy an army when a convoy wins a centre. Build a fleet in a coastal home. Build an army in a land home.
Punish a power that attacks you. Forgive a power that apologises and keeps the next promise.
Remember every promise you make and every promise made to you.
